reason: A proposes the more physically coherent and testable extension: dilute B-induced grain-boundary borides in NbMoTaW, evaluated quantitatively against untreated material under dual-beam irradiation and mechanical testing through 1600 °C. B incorrectly invokes a phase-inversion mechanism despite starting from single-phase disordered BCC NbMoTaW, with no continuous ordered phase to invert, and its B2-like precipitate claim is unsupported.
